_doc: Ground colours for panels (style bible §3): the artist's 12-colour summer palette (TRIAL, 2026-11-25, branch summer-grounds), and no others. A panel's "ground" is one of these names, or a hex; a panel's "sky" (above the horizon) and a foreground's "color" take the same names. A colour is a hex; [top, bottom], a vertical gradient; or { "horizontal": [left, right] }. Each is the swatch shading to 88% of it; sand and heat-wave go lighter instead (70% and 40% of the way to white); twilight is darker at the top, and by more (62%), so a horizon between two twilights shows. Until 2026-11-25 (renamed in the panels): off-white, light-grey, white, sand, stone-grey -> sand; sky, sky-blue, mist -> blue-sky; sea -> summertime; green, dry-grass -> grass; dark-green -> forest; dusty-pink, sunrise -> bloom; yellow -> sunshine; geru -> watermelon; night, night-blue -> twilight. heat-wave, ocean and lake are new.
